notes.subject: כְּבַלַּע
notes.rationale: The preposition + piel infinitive of בלע 'to swallow' occurs only here with this sense in the Tanakh; the literal picture 'as a swallowing' (i.e., for even a moment, in the blink of swallowing) is kept.

notes.subject: כְּבַלַּע
notes.rationale: Renderings divide: 'for even a moment' (idiomatic) versus the literal swallowing picture; the literal is kept per the lay-it-bare rule.

notes.subject: the holy
notes.rationale: The verse guards the sanctuary from being seen — access withheld, a boundary of concealment.

translation: And they shall not come in to see, as a swallowing, ⟨את⟩ the holy ⟨thing⟩, and die.
